---
title: "4. Deep Learning Fundamentals"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 12 weeks  
**Outcome:** Implement MLPs, embeddings, attention and transformer blocks in PyTorch.
:::

## Core topics

PyTorch; automatic differentiation; MLPs; optimisation; embeddings; attention; transformers; training and evaluation.

## Essential resources

- MIT **6.S191: Introduction to Deep Learning** — <https://introtodeeplearning.com/>
- Stanford **CS336: Language Modeling from Scratch** — <https://cs336.stanford.edu/>
- Zhang, A., Lipton, Z. C., Li, M., & Smola, A. J. *Dive into Deep Learning*. <https://d2l.ai/>
- Vaswani, A., et al. (2017). Attention is all you need. *NeurIPS 30*.

## Milestone

Implement a small transformer without using a high-level transformer module and train it on a modest dataset.
